description:
DNG Ryan are delighted to present 51 Ashdale, Dún An Óir, Kanturk, Co. Cork to the market for sale. This impressive three-bedroom, three-bathroom end-of-terrace residence offers exceptionally spacious and beautifully presented accommodation, extending to approximately 137 sq.m. and ideally positioned within walking distance of Kanturk town and its wide range of amenities.

Built C. 2006, the property has undergone extensive upgrading and refurbishment within the last three years and is presented to the market in excellent turnkey condition. The contemporary finish throughout creates a bright, comfortable and inviting home, allowing the new owners to move in and enjoy the property immediately without the need for further works.

One of the standout features of No. 51 is its generous proportions. Extending to C. 137 sq.m., the property provides an excellent level of living and bedroom accommodation, considerably enhancing its appeal as a family home. The end-of-terrace position further adds to the sense of space and privacy.

The property comprises three well-proportioned bedrooms and three bathrooms, complemented by spacious living accommodation ideally suited to modern family life. Practical features include a central vacuum system, water softener and a floored attic, providing valuable additional storage space.

Externally, the property benefits from off-street parking to the front, while to the rear lies an attractive garden complete with decking, providing an ideal space for outdoor dining, entertaining or relaxing during the warmer months.

The home is serviced by oil-fired central heating and holds an impressive B3 Building Energy Rating, making it eligible for a Green Mortgage with participating lenders. Combined with the recent improvements to the property, this offers prospective purchasers the benefit of a comfortable and energy-efficient home.

The location is another major advantage, with Kanturk town within walking distance, providing convenient access to shops, schools, cafés, sporting facilities and everyday services. The property offers an excellent balance between the convenience of town living and the space and comfort of a substantial modern home.

51 Ashdale represents an excellent opportunity to acquire a spacious, energy-efficient and turnkey three-bedroom home in a highly convenient Kanturk location. With its generous C. 137 sq.m. floor area, B3 energy rating, recent refurbishment, end-of-terrace position and attractive outdoor space, this is a property that is sure to appeal to first-time buyers, families and those seeking a quality home close to the heart of Kanturk.

Viewing is highly recommended and is strictly by appointment with sole selling agents DNG Ryan.
